patch_resolves_note: The staged fix changes the packed-mode guard in `basic_format_args::do_get()` from `index > internal::max_packed_args` to `index >= internal::max_packed_args`, so the same `{12}` witness now returns before `type(index)` or `values_[index]` execute.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before packed lookup continues into `type(index)` or `values_[index]`, `basic_format_args::do_get()` must reject every `index` that is not strictly less than `internal::max_packed_args`.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the crashing `{12}` witness, packed lookup runs with `index == internal::max_packed_args`, but the vulnerable guard checks only `index > internal::max_packed_args` and therefore admits the nonexistent packed slot 12.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The fixed original is guarded on the saved `{12}` witness because the protected copy does not execute there, so the required assertion is differentially verified with the adjacent `{0}` numeric-id perturbation, where the same `do_get()` path executes the protected copy under a genuinely in-range packed slot.

nodes.description: Immediately after `arg.type_ = type(index);`, the vulnerable packed lookup classifies the admitted slot-12 lookup as a real argument because `arg.type_ != internal::type::none_type`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `packed_arg_type_probe.resolved_type != packed_arg_type_probe.none_type_tag` for the crashing `{12}` case.

nodes.description: At the sanitizer sink, `basic_format_args::do_get()` executes `val = values_[index];` with the same admitted packed-slot index that violated the root guard, so the copy reads slot 12 from a packed-value array that has no valid index 12.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `packed_arg_guard.requested_index == packed_arg_copy.requested_index == 12` while the root predicate `requested_index < max_packed_args` is violated.

edges.relation: The same `index` value that slips past the off-by-one packed-argument guard is later used unchanged as the subscript in `values_[index]`.
The same non-`none_type` `arg.type_` computed for the admitted slot-12 lookup remains live at the copy site, so the early return is bypassed and `val = values_[index];` executes.
